newsitem.title: LATVIA: AIR BALTIC DOUBLES Q1 PASSENGERS - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: AIR BALTIC DOUBLES Q1 PASSENGERS - REPORT.

text.p: Latvia's Air Baltic doubled passenger turnover to 33,305 in the first quarter from 14,934 in the same period last year, Dienas Bizness newspaper said on Friday.
Air Baltic, nearly one third owned by Scandinavian Airlines, has said it plans to break even in 1997.
The newspaper quoted senior deputy president Oleg Korsche as saying that if the passenger turnover growth continues, Air Baltic hopes to carry 150,000 to 160,000 passengers this year.

The Copenhagen-Geneva route gave Air Baltic the biggest share of turnover or 7,300 passengers during the first quarter while Riga-Copenhagen and Riga-Kiev were second and third, Korshe told the newspaper.
Air Baltic currently brings in 25 percent of Riga airport pasenger turnover which is planned to be increased to some 40 percent in future, Korshe said.
